text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While putting away the equipment after 
training with Hokko Tarumae—
Oh, Prince~! Please watch over me~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... Hmph... How's that, Prince?! I'm 
still gonna hit 'em with everything I've 
got!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa, Kawakami-san, you're sweating 
buckets...!? Maybe you should take a break 
soon...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... If I just picture the Prince's 
smile... in my princess brain... ...this 
is a piece of cake...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
For PriFigh, seeing the prince's smile 
after a victory is the greatest driving 
force of all! And I realized that it's the 
exact same for me!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah... I get that... Whenever I picture 
the smiling faces of everyone back in 
Tomakomai, it gives me strength too..."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
choice_data_list: That'll lead to overwork, so let's not.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Bonds are power!! Let's do our best 
together... Tarumae-san!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Everyone back in Tomakomai! I'm 
gonna work even harder, so watch me~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Please keep your eyes on me, Prince!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since she had already completed her normal 
menu, I explained that doing any more 
would be dangerous.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"You are right... indeed. Pushing myself 
too hard would only worry them more, after 
all."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami-san, please do your best for my 
sake too...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Thank you ever so much! I'll give it 
everything I've got, for Tarumae-san's 
sake too!
